newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil barges firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil barges firm.

text.p: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil barges were firmer on Thursday although cargoes were more timid, traders said.
Barges traded at $116, $116.50, $117, $117.50 and $118 fob ARA. But bunker demand was not robust and ARA dealers attributed the rise more to individual players' trading strategies than anything else.

Cargo markets were thinner after recent deals which covered a number of short positions. A trader was thought to have covered a utility requirement on Wednesday at a price a little below the high of published quotes.
Low sulphur markets were little changed, and Oct swaps were heard offered at $125 fob NWE, slightly below late Wednesday's levels.
Low sulphur straight-run markets were looking perkier. One seller assessed the market at around $136/7 fob NWE, and a regular buyer said business was not likely to be done far below these levels.
